description: This Java class 'IoUtil' provides utility methods for sending commands, waiting for responses, changing RPM settings, launching simulators, and managing hardware connections within a project related to engine control or ECU testing.

classes.name: IoUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to facilitate command communication, RPM adjustments, simulator launching, and hardware connections for engine control.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command string to the external system and waits for confirmation, with default timeouts.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command with specified retry and total timeout values, waits for confirmation, and handles error conditions.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Awaits a CountDownLatch for a specified number of seconds, throwing exception if interrupted.

methods.name: changeRpm
methods.description: Adjusts engine RPM by sending command and waiting until the sensor indicates the RPM change has taken effect.

methods.name: waitForFirstResponse
methods.description: Pauses execution to wait for the first RPM sensor signal, indicating startup readiness.

methods.name: launchSimulator
methods.description: Starts a simulation environment, initializes TCP connection, and waits for the system to be ready.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Pauses execution for a given number of seconds.

methods.name: realHardwareConnect
methods.description: Establishes connection to real hardware through specified port and registers callbacks.
